intro: The Gifted Girl Kim LLC (“we,” “us,” or “our”) publishes Digital Chapel. This privacy policy explains how the app handles information.

blocks.text: Digital Chapel is published and operated by The Gifted Girl Kim LLC.

Creating an account is optional. If you choose to sign in, Digital Chapel uses email magic-link authentication through Supabase: we send a sign-in link to your email and maintain your session. Your account email and user identifier may be stored so you can sync progress and Chapel Plus AI allowance across devices.

Guest mode works without an account for Bible reading, on-device narration, complimentary AI Bible Teacher asks, Chapel Plus purchase and restore through the App Store or Google Play, Prayer Circle participation, sermon/song submissions, and local preferences.

sections.heading: Scripture Notes, Highlights, Saved Content & Sync

blocks.text: Highlights, notes, saved scriptures, journey progress, and reading rewards may be stored on your device. When you are signed in, some of this data may sync through Supabase for cross-device access.
AI Bible Teacher helps you study selected Bible passages.
Provider: Google Gemini, accessed through our server-side Supabase infrastructure. API secrets are stored only on the server and are not embedded in the app.
What is transmitted for AI processing:

items: Selected Bible book, chapter, and verse reference
Selected verse text
The request type needed to answer (for example explain, context, or follow-up)

blocks.text: What is not intentionally transmitted to the AI provider as part of the prompt:

items: Your email address
Device advertising identifiers
A Digital Chapel password (magic-link sign-in does not use passwords)

blocks.text: Guest complimentary asks: up to 3 successful free asks are tracked on your device. Failed requests are not counted. Additional AI use requires Chapel Plus. Signed-in Chapel Plus members have a separate monthly allowance enforced on our servers.
AI responses can be wrong. AI Bible Teacher is informational spiritual study assistance and is not clergy, medical care, mental-health care, or emergency assistance.
AI Consent
Before the first AI request leaves your device, Digital Chapel shows an in-app AI disclosure. You must choose Continue to AI before any AI request is transmitted.
You can review the disclosure later in You → AI Bible Teacher → Review AI disclosure.

You can withdraw AI third-party processing consent at any time in You → AI Bible Teacher → Withdraw AI Consent. After you withdraw, future AI Bible Teacher requests will not leave your device until you choose Continue to AI again. Withdrawal is stored on this device and applies to AI Bible Teacher use on that device.
Routine AI prompts and responses are processed to generate an answer and are not kept as a permanent chat history in Digital Chapel.

If you use Report on an AI answer, Digital Chapel stores a report that may include the passage reference, a short excerpt of the AI answer, your reason, and whether the report was submitted as a guest or a signed-in member. These reports are retained for safety review and may be deleted after review or when no longer needed. Guest users may report an AI answer without creating an account.

Prayer Circle posts (prayer requests, praise, and healing stories) may be published immediately and are visible to other users. Posts appear under the anonymous label “Fellowship Member.” Digital Chapel does not publicly display the poster’s account identity.
New posts (ownership-aware)

For new Prayer/Praise posts going forward, Digital Chapel uses a privacy-safe ownership mechanism so the submitting device or signed-in member can later remove only that post. Ownership details are not shown publicly. On posts you own, you may see Delete My Prayer, which removes that post from the public wall. You cannot delete another person’s post.
Legacy anonymous posts

Older posts created before this ownership mechanism are not retroactively associated with user accounts. For those posts, you may Hide a post from your own device view, Report it for review, or contact us for help. The Digital Chapel owner may remove content that violates Community Guidelines.

Chapel sermon and song submissions may collect your name, church or organization, email address, and an uploaded audio or video file. Submissions are reviewed before publication. Contact details are used to manage your submission.
When you submit, Digital Chapel may provide a cryptographically random removal code. Please save that code if you may later want a verified removal request.
Requesting removal of a sermon or song submission
You do not need a Digital Chapel account to request removal. Use Chapel → Request Removal / Withdraw Submission, or You → Contact / Request Data or Content Removal.

items: Verified requests: If you present the removal code from your original submission, Digital Chapel can create a verified removal request linked for owner review.

Unverified legacy / manual-verification requests: If you do not have a removal code (including older submissions from before removal codes), you may still submit a removal request with contact details and title information for manual owner review. Knowing someone’s email address and title alone is not treated as proof of ownership. Unverified requests are clearly marked for manual verification.
Nothing is removed automatically by a removal request. Owner review is required before a submission or uploaded file is removed.
Arbitrary users cannot withdraw someone else’s submission.

sections.heading: Purchases (App Store / StoreKit and Google Play)

blocks.text: Chapel Plus subscriptions are processed by Apple (App Store / StoreKit) and, on Android, by Google Play. We may store subscription entitlement and purchase-event information needed to unlock features and prevent fraud. Apple and Google handle payment card details; we do not receive your full payment card number.
Product identifiers include:

items: digitalchapel.plus.monthly
digitalchapel.plus.yearly

blocks.text: Managing or canceling a subscription is done through your Apple ID or Google Play subscription settings. Deleting Digital Chapel account data does not cancel a store subscription.

Daily Verse reminders use on-device local notifications. They are optional. If enabled, Digital Chapel schedules reminders locally on your device. We do not collect a push notification token for this feature.
Bible narration uses on-device text-to-speech (device voices / Web Speech). Digital Chapel does not send Scripture text to a cloud text-to-speech vendor for narration.

Community reports (for example, Prayer Circle reports) and AI answer reports may include the content needed to investigate a concern, such as a post reference or AI excerpt, your reason, and timestamps. We minimize identifying information where practical—for example, Prayer posts display publicly as “Fellowship Member,” and guest AI reports need not include an account identifier.
Owner tools are used to review reports and remove violating Prayer Circle posts or other content when appropriate.

Safety and moderation reports may be retained as needed for security, fraud prevention, moderation, and legal compliance. They are not deleted merely because you delete your Digital Chapel account data, and the app does not provide user self-deletion of abuse or safety reports you submitted.
We do not sell your personal information.
Digital Chapel is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. Contact us if you believe a child has provided personal information.
What Delete Account deletes

When you use You → Delete Digital Chapel Account while signed in, Digital Chapel deletes account-linked and synced Digital Chapel data we control for this app, including supported synced reading progress, notes, highlights, preferences, purchase entitlement and purchase-event records, and related Digital Chapel AI usage records for your account.
After a successful server deletion, the app also clears Digital Chapel-specific on-device data on that device and returns you to a clean Guest state.
What may remain and why

items: Shared authentication identity may remain because the same Supabase sign-in can be used by other Kimberly App Studio apps. Delete Account does not delete that shared sign-in identity.

Prayer/Praise posts are not automatically deleted by Delete Account. Use Delete My Prayer for owned new posts when available; use Hide, Report, owner moderation, or Contact / Request Data or Content Removal for legacy anonymous posts and other cases.
Sermon and song submissions are not automatically deleted with Delete Account; use Request Removal or Contact Support.
Safety and moderation reports may remain as needed for security, fraud prevention, moderation, or legal compliance.
Some information may also remain in backups or logs for a limited period.

blocks.text: How Prayer / Praise content can be removed

items: New owned posts: Delete My Prayer on the public wall (same device ownership or the signed-in creating member).
Legacy anonymous posts: Hide (device-only), Report, owner moderation, or Contact / Request Data or Content Removal.
You cannot delete another person’s Prayer/Praise post.

blocks.text: How sermon / song submissions can be removed

items: Chapel → Request Removal / Withdraw Submission (verified with removal code when available; otherwise unverified legacy/manual review).
Or You → Contact / Request Data or Content Removal.
Owner review is required; removal is not automatic.

blocks.text: Store subscriptions
Deleting Digital Chapel account data does not cancel App Store or Google Play subscriptions. Manage or cancel Chapel Plus through your Apple ID or Google Play account settings.
On-device preferences

On-device preferences, AI consent choice, guest AI ask counts, and similar local Digital Chapel settings remain until you change them, clear app data, uninstall, or complete Delete Account (which clears Digital Chapel local data on that device after a successful server deletion).
Depending on features you use, processing may involve:

items: Supabase (authentication and data sync)
Google Gemini via our server-side Supabase infrastructure (AI Bible Teacher)
Apple App Store / Google Play (subscriptions)
On-device text-to-speech (narration; not a cloud text-to-speech vendor)

blocks.text: When we use third-party processors that receive user data to provide these services, we expect and require them to protect that information in a manner consistent with this privacy policy and applicable legal requirements, including through contractual or platform terms where available. Processors may only use the information as needed to provide their services to us (and as otherwise required by law).
We may update this policy as the app evolves. The effective date at the top will change when updates are posted.

sections.heading: Contact / Request Data or Content Removal

blocks.text: Questions about privacy for Digital Chapel, or requests to remove data or content, can be sent to thegiftedgirlkim@gmail.com.
In the app, you can also use:

items: You → Contact Support
You → Contact / Request Data or Content Removal
Chapel → Request Removal / Withdraw Submission (for sermon or song submissions)
